## System Name
What system do you want to add? (e.g. "Design Slack", "Design Zoom")

## Why This System?
What makes it a good system design interview problem? What architectural challenges does it have?

## Difficulty
- [ ] Easy
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] Hard

## Estimated Time
How long should a candidate spend on this? (e.g. 30 min, 45 min, 60 min)

## Proposed Requirements (Functional)
List 4-6 functional requirements.

## Proposed Constraints (Scale)
List 2-3 scale constraints with real numbers (e.g. "50M DAU", "1B messages/day").

## Key Architectural Challenges
What are the hardest parts of designing this system? (These become hints)

## Are you willing to implement it?
- [ ] Yes, I'll open a PR
- [ ] No, just proposing the idea
